lessons.goal: 比對運動紀錄的距離與時間，避免只看數字大小。

questions.evidence: Running club chat: I finished today's practice in twelve minutes, two minutes faster than last week. I think my speed has improved a lot. The message includes a photo of a watch, but no route description or distance is shown beside it.
questions.explanation: 原訊息有時間，沒有距離及路線。
questions.prompt: What is missing from the first message?

questions.evidence: Coach: Was today's route the same length? Runner: Last week we used four laps of the track. Today the inside lane was closed, so we ran three laps and then stopped at the side gate. I did not measure the final distance.
questions.prompt: How many track laps did last week's practice use?

questions.evidence:
Running club chat: I finished today's practice in twelve minutes, two minutes faster than last week. I think my speed has improved a lot. The message includes a photo of a watch, but no route description or distance is shown beside it.

Coach: Was today's route the same length? Runner: Last week we used four laps of the track. Today the inside lane was closed, so we ran three laps and then stopped at the side gate. I did not measure the final distance.

Coach: Then the shorter time alone cannot show a faster pace. Record distance as well as duration next time. You can still note that you completed today's planned session; just avoid comparing two different routes as if they were equal.

Another teammate offers to draw the next route and mark its start and finish. The group agrees to keep weather and any interruptions in their notes too. A useful record gives enough context for a comparison, rather than only the most impressive number.
questions.explanation: 距離不同，時間較少不一定速度較快。
questions.prompt: Why can't twelve minutes alone prove improved pace?

questions.evidence: Coach: Then the shorter time alone cannot show a faster pace. Record distance as well as duration next time. You can still note that you completed today's planned session; just avoid comparing two different routes as if they were equal.
questions.explanation: duration 是時間長度，與 distance 對照。
options: The color of the closed lane.

options: A gate photo with no measurement.
Only the smallest time on the watch.
Distance, time, route, and relevant interruptions.
A teammate's guess about the runner's mood.
